newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-ELTINGH/HAARHUIS WIN DOUBLES, KEEP DUTCH HOPES ALIVE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ELTINGH/HAARHUIS WIN DOUBLES, KEEP DUTCH HOPES ALIVE.

text.p: Paul Haarhuis and Jacco Eltingh kept the Netherlands' Davis Cup hopes alive for at least another day by knocking off Rick Leach and Jonathan Stark 6-4 6-4 3-6 6-3 in doubles Saturday.
But the Dutch still trailed the United States 2-1 after the two hour, 24 minute match.
Andre Agassi and Jim Courier will try to close out the best-of-five Davis Cup quarter-final with a singles victory Sunday that would advance the Americans to a September 19-21 clash with Australia.
Both posted singles wins on Friday to give the United States a 2-0 advantage.
In a reversal of Friday's singles, Agassi will face Jan Semerink in the opener. Courier will tangle with Sjeng Schalken in the fifth match, if necessary.
The Dutch are bidding to become only the eighth team in world group play history to win a tie after falling behind 2-0.
